duration.value: 1 minute/level DESCRIPTION You grow vampirelike fangs that allow you to make bite attacks as natural attacks. Your bite attack deals 1d6 points of damage + your strength modifier, and 1 point of Constitution damage. If you make a full attack with other weapons, you can make a bite attack as a natural secondary attack.
